test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 11 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Consider the following statements about the 2015 India-Bangladesh Land Boundary Agreement (LBA):

1) As per the 2015 agreement, 51 Bangladeshi enclaves in India and 111 Indian enclaves in Bangladesh were exchanged.

2) A majority of enclave residents from Bangladesh opted to retain Bangladeshi citizenship after the transfer.

Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Only 1 is Correct**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **2015 Land Boundary Agreement (LBA)** was a historic treaty between **India** and **Bangladesh** that facilitated the transfer of **111 Indian enclaves** (adversely held territories) located in Bangladesh and **51 Bangladeshi enclaves** located in India.
